title: Velantrim Answer Trace
description: Replayable receipt that proves how an answer was constructed from stored facts. A trace must be verifiable offline without the LLM that produced the answer.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this trace / receipt

query.description: The original user query that triggered retrieval

answer.description: The generated answer, or null if no Validated/Supported facts were available (insufficient-grounding block)

steps.description: Ordered pipeline steps from retrieval through grounding to generation

fact_ids.description: fact_ids of facts used or produced in this step

total_facts.description: Number of facts used to ground the answer
